text: Hujja ummital ngal no woodani fennuɓe ɓen: e leydi yoorundi hokki ndin, Men jippini toɓo e mayri, immorde ka kammu, Men fuɗini e mayri nooneeji puɗi, Men yaltini nooneeji e gabbe, e nder ɗin puɗi, fii ko yimɓe ɓen ñaama. Yo ɓe anndu non, wuurnirɗo ndin leydi ɗon non, ko hattanɗo wuurnitugol maayɓe.
